questions.q_en: A textbook revision card states "They absorb very little moisture and allow poor air circulation". Identify the correct heading.

questions.exp_en: Moisture absorption of most synthetic fibres: They absorb very little moisture and allow poor air circulation.

questions.exp_en: Why plastics are popular: They are lightweight, strong, mouldable, flexible, waterproof, sometimes UV-resistant, cheap and convenient.
